# Test evidence template

Copy to a named evidence file; do not mark this blank template as evidence. Include: T-/R-/AT- IDs; date/tester; commit/build/model/data/audio versions; device/OS/browser/API environment; preconditions and fixture origin/demo labels; exact commands/actions; expected result; observed result; result PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED; logs/screenshots/DB-count paths; security/privacy redaction; failures/fixes/retest scope; limitations. Add independent checks for a claim where needed. A case with multiple acceptance clauses passes only when all are verified.
